setup: git clone https://github.com/receiptful/escpost build/external/escpost && git -C build/external/escpost checkout c4a7665
notes: Exercises the smallest job of the repository, an initialize, two lines and a cut. The sample names no profile and no width, so it is rendered on the 80 mm paper of the other fixtures, 576 dots. The stream is the hexadecimal file of the repository, not a run of the library. Reviewed against ESCPost's own render, which is the same paper: 120 dots and 36 ink rows in both.
